name: Scene one: the quay in the rain
description: The first of two scenes to move between (try: playground cycle scene_quay scene_tavern). A generated rainy quay behind the stage, Finn's portrait, his line from the game's storyteller, and the sound of rain. The picture, portrait and line were made by the project's image and text services.

caption.speaker: Finn Alder
caption.text: The harbour stays busy even in the rain. At dusk the quay turns slick under the lanterns, while merchants drift up toward the market road.

phone.goal: Get the courier out of the rain
narration: Rain drums on the boards. Finn keeps the packet tight against his coat and glances at every shadow on the quay.
